title: feat: protocol-layer constants and storage name mapping for object/field decoupling
body:
System objects (user, session, account) are currently referenced by hardcoded strings throughout API/SDK/permissions, tightly coupling protocol-layer identifiers to physical DB table/column names. This adds the protocol-layer constants and mapping infrastructure to decouple them.

### Changes

- **`SystemObjectName` / `SystemFieldName` constants** — single source of truth for protocol-layer identifiers (`user`, `session`, `account`, `verification`, `sys_metadata`, `id`, `created_at`, `owner_id`, etc.)
- **`columnName` on `FieldSchema`** — optional physical column name override, defaults to field key
- **`StorageNameMapping` utilities** — pure functions for engine/driver layer: `resolveTableName`, `resolveColumnName`, `buildColumnMap`, `buildReverseColumnMap`
- **Exports wired** from `system/constants/index.ts` → `system/index.ts`
- **ROADMAP updated**

`tableName` on `ObjectSchema` already existed — no change needed there.

### Usage

```ts
import { SystemObjectName, SystemFieldName, StorageNameMapping } from '@objectstack/spec/system';

// Protocol layer always uses constants
const users = await engine.find(SystemObjectName.USER, {
  filters: [SystemFieldName.OWNER_ID, '=', currentUserId],
});

// Driver layer resolves physical names
const table = StorageNameMapping.resolveTableName(objectDef); // 'ba_users' or 'user'
const col = StorageNameMapping.resolveColumnName('user_id', field); // 'userId' or 'user_id'
const colMap = StorageNameMapping.buildColumnMap(objectDef.fields);
const reverseMap = StorageNameMapping.buildReverseColumnMap(objectDef.fields);
```

### Object definition with storage mapping

```ts
ObjectSchema.create({
  name: 'user',
  tableName: 'ba_users',       // physical table
  fields: {
    email: { type: 'email', columnName: 'email_address' },
    created_at: { type: 'datetime', columnName: 'createdAt' },
  },
});
```

19 new tests added. All 5,643 tests pass.

> *This section details on the original issue you should resolve*
> 
> <issue_title>支持系统对象名与表名/字段名解耦（协议层常量与存储层映射设计）</issue_title>
> <issue_description>## 背景
> 当前内核���服务的数据对象在 API/协议层（如 user、session、account）与实际数据库表名/字段名强绑定，导致：
> - 前端、SDK、权限系统必须硬编码表名、字段名
> - 后端迁移、扩展难以无损修改（如 DB 分表、兼容旧系统等）
> 
> 参考 better-auth 机制，宜在协议层（前端 API、SDK、ObjectQL Engine）和存储层（DB Driver/Table/Column）之间加入映射层，支持表名/字段名自由配置。
> 
> ## 需求
> 1. 在 `@objectstack/spec/system` 中新增 `SystemObjectName` 和 `SystemFieldName` 常量，统一协议层引用（如 user、session、owner_id）。
> 2. 在 `ObjectSchema` 增加 `tableName` 字段，允许后端指定实际存储表名，默认与 `name` 相同。
> 3. 在 Field 定义增加 `columnName` 字段，允许指定实际存储列名，默认与 key 相同。
> 4. ObjectQL Engine/Driver 层实现 protocol name ↔ tableName，field key ↔ columnName 的双向转换。
> 5. 保证前端 API/SDK/权限检查/元数据自描述等全部依赖 `SystemObjectName`（协议层唯一来源），而不是实际表名。
> 6. 现有插件（如 plugin-auth）加适配支持。
> 
> ## 好处
> - 前后端完全解耦
> - 支持 DB 迁移/多驱动/分表/分库/兼容场景
> - 升级不会破坏前端/插件开发者
> - 支持多租户/多 schema 下表名冲突自动化
> 
> ## 参考链接
> - [better-auth 官方数据库自定义机制](https://www.better-auth.com/docs/concepts/database#custom-tables)
> - [spec/plugin-auth/objectql-adapter.js 源码分析](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/spec/blob/main/packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/objectql-adapter.ts)
